content: Godaa qaalay haysada yaagishe taako yis.
“Asa na7aw, woyney woran de7iya hara mithafe aybin aadhii?
Go77i de7iya ba oothanaw qanxetidi eriyee? Aykoba kaqiya kocaa iyape kessanaw danda7eetii?
Iya tama oysethanaw taman yeggin, xeeraynne dulley taman meetetin attida dunchay ay maaddanee?
Xuugetonna de7ishe, ayko maaddonnaysi tami min miccidi ay maaddanee?”
Hessa gisho, Ubbaa Haariya Goday haysada yaagees: “Taani woran de7iya mithaa giddofe woyne mithaa tamas aathada immidaysada Yerusalaamen de7iya asaa hessada oothana.
Taani ta som7uwa enta bolla zaarana; enti issi tamape keykoka, hara tami enta maana. Taani ta som7uwa enta bolla zaariya wode taani Godaa gideysa hinte erana.
Enti tanan ammanetona aggida gisho ta enta biitta baysa kessana” yaagees Ubbaa Haariya Goday.
